title: Staging deployments
description: What is deployed to staging, when it changed and whether rollouts are healthy: Argo CD sync and health, running image tags, rollout progress, restarts, and deploy annotations.

list.name: Deployment rollouts
list.expr: max by (namespace, deployment, replicaset) (max by (namespace, replicaset) (kube_replicaset_created{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (deployment) max by (namespace, replicaset, deployment) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind="Deployment"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))) * 1000

panels.title: Apps out of sync
panels.description: Argo CD applications whose live state differs from Git.

panels.title: Apps unhealthy
panels.description: Argo CD applications not reporting Healthy (Progressing, Degraded, Missing, Suspended or Unknown).

panels.title: Syncs in range
panels.description: Argo CD sync operations in the selected time range. The counter resets when the application controller restarts.

panels.title: Failed syncs in range
panels.description: Argo CD sync operations that ended in Error or Failed in the selected time range.

panels.title: Rollouts in progress
panels.description: Deployments that have not finished rolling out: fewer updated replicas than desired, or a spec change the controller has not observed yet.

targets.expr: count(((max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_updated{namespace=~"$namespace"})) < (max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace=~"$namespace"}))) or ((max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_metadata_generation{namespace=~"$namespace"})) > (max by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_observed_generation{namespace=~"$namespace"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Last rollout
panels.description: When the newest Deployment ReplicaSet was created, i.e. the latest pod template change (image tag, env or config).

panels.title: Restarts in range
panels.description: Container restarts in the selected namespaces and time range.

targets.expr: round(sum(max by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__range])))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Containers stuck
panels.description: Containers currently waiting in CrashLoopBackOff, image pull errors or container config errors.

targets.expr: count(max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{namespace=~"$namespace", reason=~"CrashLoopBackOff|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|CreateContainerConfigError|CreateContainerError"} == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Applications
panels.description: Sync and health status of every Argo CD application, with the number of syncs in the selected range.

targets.expr: max by (name, project, dest_namespace, sync_status, health_status, autosync_enabled) (argocd_app_info{name=~"$app"})

panels.title: Syncs per application
panels.description: Argo CD sync operations per interval, split by result phase.

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum by (name, phase) (argocd_app_sync_total{name=~"$app"}) - sum by (name, phase) (argocd_app_sync_total{name=~"$app"} offset $__interval), 0) > 0

panels.title: Running images
panels.description: Image tag per container for every Deployment and StatefulSet. During a rollout a workload shows both the old and new tag; Pods is the number of containers running that image.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(count by (namespace, workload, container, image_spec) (max by (namespace, pod, container, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (replicaset) max by (namespace, pod, replicaset) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind="ReplicaSet"}, "replicaset", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")) * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, replicaset, workload) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind="Deployment"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))), "kind", "Deployment", "__name__", ""), "tag", "$1", "image_spec", ".*:([^:/]+)") or label_replace(label_replace(count by (namespace, workload, container, image_spec) (max by (namespace, pod, container, image_spec) (kube_pod_container_info{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (workload) max by (namespace, pod, workload) (label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind="StatefulSet"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))), "kind", "StatefulSet", "__name__", ""), "tag", "$1", "image_spec", ".*:([^:/]+)")

panels.title: Deployments
panels.description: Replica state per Deployment. Last rollout is when its newest ReplicaSet was created.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, deployment) (max by (namespace, replicaset) (kube_replicaset_created{namespace=~"$namespace"}) * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (deployment) max by (namespace, replicaset, deployment) (label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace=~"$namespace", owner_kind="Deployment"}, "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))) * 1000

panels.title: StatefulSets
panels.description: Replica state per StatefulSet. Updated below Desired means a rolling update is still in progress.

panels.title: Rollout progress (updated / desired)
panels.description: Share of replicas running the current pod template. A dip below 100% is a rollout in progress.

panels.title: Unavailable replicas
panels.description: Replicas that are desired but not available. Short spikes during rollouts are expected; sustained values are not.

targets.expr: clamp_min(max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) - max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"} offset $__interval), 0) > 0

panels.title: Last container terminations
panels.description: Why each restarted container last stopped (OOMKilled, Error, ...), with exit code and total restarts of the current pod.

targets.expr: max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"$namespace"}) and on (namespace, pod, container) kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{namespace=~"$namespace"}

panels.title: Containers waiting now
panels.description: Containers that are not running right now and why (ContainerCreating, CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, ...).
